'''Jack Douglass''' (GEMP handle '''JekBear''')<ref name="gempc-83998">[https://forum.starwarsccg.org/viewtopic.php?t=83998 Registered Players - 128], 8th GEMP Match Play Championship, forum.starwarsccg.org (2 January 2024). [[:File:SWCCG forum t83998 2024 GEMPC Registered Players.txt]]</ref> finished '''16th''' in [[2026 Retro League Event 1|Event 1 of the 2026 Retro League]].<ref name="rl26e1final" /> Douglass also finished '''#59''' at the [[2026 Tenth Annual GEMPC]] (Lost Round of 64; Challonge seed 59).<ref name="pc-gempc">[https://www.starwarsccg.org/2026-06-tenth-annual-gempc-may-to-july-2026/ 2026-06 Tenth Annual GEMPC], starwarsccg.org</ref><ref name="challonge">[https://challonge.com/18vokbxb Challonge 18vokbxb]</ref>
